content:
marta (acct): New enterprise commit signed, 12mo. Customer runs two weekly promos, expecting baseline ~500 concurrent, peaking to ~2400 for ~10-25 minutes. They want: reserved GPU recommendation, burst/autoscale mix (spot vs on-demand), quick price sketch, and security notes about prewarming + KMS. Can we put together a short playbook?

leo (solutions): Quick take: reserve for 95th steady-state, keep a small hot prewarm pool per-region for instant spikes, and a larger spot-backed burst pool. Provide burst credits on contract.

anya (infra): Ops constraints: spot cold starts ~3-6m, on-demand ~1-3m. Recommend prewarm per-AZ (1-3 GPUs) and cross-AZ spread. Decide whether prewarm runs in customer VPC for sensitive workloads.

marta (acct): Customer SLO: 99% <= 220ms token latency. Model: LlamaX-34B quant. Avg reply ~130 tokens, average think-time ~18s during promos.

ravi (eng-runtime): Measured with tight batching LlamaX-34B-quant -> ~520 tps/GPU for short seqs with good KV cache hits. To hit 220ms we must cap batch delay and keep max-batch small.

leo (solutions): Quick calc: peak tokens/s = 2400 * 130 / 18 = ~17,333 tps. At 520 tps/GPU -> ~34 GPUs. Add 25% headroom -> ~42 GPUs for peak. Steady 95th (500 concurrent): 500*130/18 = ~3,611 tps -> ~7 GPUs. Propose: reserved commit = 8 GPUs, hot prewarm pool = 8 GPUs (per-region spread), burst pool target = 36 GPUs (mix spot/on-demand).

anya (infra): Prewarm plan: always-on hot-pool 8 GPUs split across AZs (e.g., 3/3/2), spot burst + on-demand fallback. Preheat recommends starting 10 minutes before scheduled promos; for unexpected bursts rely on hot-pool + fallback to 13B variant.

ravi (eng-runtime): Autoscale snippet (pseudo):
```
autoscale:
  reserved: 8
  hot_pool: 8
  burst_max: 36
  burst_mix: {spot:0.65,on_demand:0.35}
  trigger: token_queue_ms > 80
  scale_step: 6 GPUs
  fallback_model: llamaX-13B-quant
```
Note: fallback kicks when queue latency sustained >120ms to preserve SLA.

leo (solutions): Pricing sketch (placeholders):
- Reserved 8 x A100-eq @ $7,500/mo/GPU = $60k/mo commit
- Hot-pool included in commit
- Burst: spot ~$1.1/hr/GPU, on-demand ~$2.8/hr/GPU. Offer 120 GPU-hours burst credit upfront. Convert to $/k requests after benchmark.

marta (acct): Security Qs: KMS for customer keys, audit for prewarm payloads, and confirmation prewarm data isn't persisted.

anya (infra): Hosted enterprise supports customer-managed KMS (envelope). Prewarm can run in customer VPC for Private option. Cache ephemeral, encrypted at rest; TTL short and auditable.

ravi (eng-runtime): We do not persist raw prompts long-term. KV cache is ephemeral and encrypted; we can anonymize prefixes for prewarm and export audit logs (job id, hashes, timestamps).

poc-bot: POC workspace created "promo-burst-212400" window 2026-04-12 -> 2026-04-19. Owners: marta, leo, anya.

marta (acct): Action items: (1) Ravi/Anya to run microbench with customer's prompt set and return per-GPU tps+latency by Mon EOD. (2) Leo to draft pricing + burst-credit proposal. (3) I'll send the security questionnaire to infra.

leo (solutions): I'll also draft an emergency runbook to flip to 13B + enable throttles.

ravi (eng-runtime): I'll include a 15/25-min spike simulation script and dashboard template.

marta (acct): Thanks all :thumbsup:
